import html from typing import List # Template for rendering a user post. Placeholders are named for clarity. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_title}

{post_body}

Posted by: {username}
{tag_elements}
""" def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a sanitized HTML representation of a user-generated post. Parameters ---------- username : str Name of the user who created the post. post_title : str Title of the post. post_body : str Main content of the post. tags : list[str] List of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready to be served to clients. """ # Escape all user-controlled input to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Build the tag elements escaped_tags = [html.escape(tag, quote=True) for tag in tags] tag_elements = " ".join(f'{t}' for t in escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, post_title=safe_title, post_body=safe_body, tag_elements=tag_elements )
